Auf einmal findet sich Shrek in einem Albtraum wieder: Oger werden gejagt, Rumpelstilzchen ist Konig und Shrek hat seine geliebte Fiona niemals kennengelernt.

programme.title: Asterix in the land of the Gotter / Asterix im Land der Gotter
programme.desc: Julius Caesar has cast almost all of Gaul with his troops, only a small village still makes resistance bitter. To defeat it, his consultants came up with something new: they build a luxury settlement near the Gallic village and involuntarily integrate it into the Roman empire. But Asterix and Obelix know how to defend themselves. The Gauls sabotage the construction work, first with fast -growing acorns and then with the help of Troubadix singing arts. / Julius Caesar hat mit seinen Truppen fast ganz Gallien besetzt, nur ein kleines Dorf leistet noch immer erbittert Widerstand. Um es zu besiegen, haben sich seine Berater etwas Neues einfallen lassen: Sie errichten eine Luxussiedlung nahe des gallischen Dorfes und gliedern es damit unfreiwillig in das Romische Imperium ein. Doch Asterix und Obelix wissen sich zu wehren. Die Gallier sabotieren die Bauarbeiten, zuerst mit schnellwachsenden Eicheln und dann mithilfe von Troubadix Gesangskunsten.

programme.title: Pets 2
programme.desc: The dog Max faces changes in his life when his owner marries and gets a baby. When the family went on a trip to the country, Max meets the dog Rooster. programme.title: Der Zoowarter
programme.desc: The zoo -hard grip is chronically exchanged by love and thinks it is time for professional change. However, his animals do not want to leave the zoo and decide to help him. The zoo carer is supposed to learn the art of animal mating behavior in order to finally succeed in women. To do this, however, the animals have to reveal him that they can speak, with which they reveal the best -handed secret of the wildlife. / Der Zoowarter Griffin ist chronisch enttauscht von der Liebe und findet, dass es Zeit fur berufliche Veranderung ist. Seine Tiere wollen jedoch nicht, dass er den Zoo verlasst, und beschlieSSen, ihm zu helfen. Der Zoowarter soll die Kunst des animalischen Paarungsverhaltens lernen, um endlich Erfolg bei den Frauen zu haben. programme.title: "We move Austria" school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: "We move Austria" school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of his state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - UEFA conference league / Fudbal - UEFA Konferencijska liga
programme.desc: From 2021. Years of football lovers enjoy the League Conference organized by UEFA. The idea for her appeared in 2015. years, and includes lower ranked teams of state championships. The qualifications are divided into two parts, after which 32 teams that are divided into eight groups per four are entered into the competition. 16 teams progresses in the eighth final, then quarterfinals, semifinals and finals. / Od 2021. godine ljubitelji fudbala uživaju Ligi Konferencija koju organizuje UEFA. Ideja za nju pojavila se 2015. godine, a uključuje niže rangirane timove državnih prvenstava. Kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dva dijela, nakon kojih u takmičenje ulaze 32 tima koji su podijeljeni u osam grupa po četiri. 16 timova napreduje u osminu finala, zatim četvrtfinale, polufinale i finale.

programme.title: Fudbal: Europaliga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of Uefe of 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. During the years, the competition format itself has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni, and every year he is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Evropa ligu. Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. programme.title: Fudbal: Europaliga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of Uefe of 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. During the years, the competition format itself has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni, and every year he is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Evropa ligu. Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of his state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - UEFA conference league / Fudbal - UEFA Konferencijska liga
programme.desc: From 2021. Years of football lovers enjoy the League Conference organized by UEFA. The idea for her appeared in 2015. years, and includes lower ranked teams of state championships. The qualifications are divided into two parts, after which 32 teams that are divided into eight groups per four are entered into the competition. 16 teams progresses in the eighth final, then quarterfinals, semifinals and finals. / Od 2021. godine ljubitelji fudbala uživaju Ligi Konferencija koju organizuje UEFA. Ideja za nju pojavila se 2015. godine, a uključuje niže rangirane timove državnih prvenstava. Kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dva dijela, nakon kojih u takmičenje ulaze 32 tima koji su podijeljeni u osam grupa po četiri. 16 timova napreduje u osminu finala, zatim četvrtfinale, polufinale i finale.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB League / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. With the dominant Russian clubs in the league, clubs from Bijelarus, Estonia, Kazakh and Latvia are also attended. Through the history of the League launched in 2008. More clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine participated. Starting from the season 2013-204. The VTB League is also the national championship for Russian clubs, from which the champion of Russia becomes best. In order for clubs to access the league must have a minimum capacity hall for 3000 viewers. The name of the VTB league comes from the General Sponsor of the League of the VTB Bank. FIBA Europe is 2013 officially recognized the league. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of his state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Fudbal: Europaliga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of Uefe of 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. During the years, the competition format itself has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni, and every year he is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Evropa ligu. Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of the Turkish basketball take far before the league of 1966. Years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that plays each with every twice in the regular part after which the play-of eight of the best teams follows. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB League / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. With the dominant Russian clubs in the league, clubs from Bijelarus, Estonia, Kazakh and Latvia are also attended. Through the history of the League launched in 2008. More clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine participated. Starting from the season 2013-204. The VTB League is also the national championship for Russian clubs, from which the champion of Russia becomes best. In order for clubs to access the league must have a minimum capacity hall for 3000 viewers. The name of the VTB league comes from the General Sponsor of the League of the VTB Bank. FIBA Europe is 2013 officially recognized the league. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of his state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Fudbal: Europaliga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of Uefe of 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. During the years, the competition format itself has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni, and every year he is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Evropa ligu. Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football - French League / Fudbal - Francuska liga
programme.desc: Ligue 1 The first is the French professional football league that has 20 teams in the fight for the title of France champions. programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of his state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Fudbal: Europaliga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of Uefe of 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. During the years, the competition format itself has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni, and every year he is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Evropa ligu. Tokom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. godine za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Cycling: Croatian Tour / Колоездене: Обиколка на Хърватия
programme.desc: The Tour of Croatia is one of the most significant events in cycling that attracts world professional teams and is part of the European Calendar of the UCI. The tour offers exciting stages that go through some of the most beautiful landscapes of Croatia-from the Adriatic coast to the interior of the country. / Обиколката на Хърватия (Tour of Croatia) е едно от най-значимите събития в колоезденето, което привлича световни професионални отбори и е част от Европейския календар на UCI. Турът предлага вълнуващи етапи, които преминават през някои от най-красивите пейзажи на Хърватия — от Адриатическото крайбрежие до вътрешността на страната.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Evulanda Slavcheva / Зала на славата: Евладия Славчева
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.title: Spartan race / Надпревара "Спартан"
programme.desc: These are exhausting competitions that combine running for endurance, strength and mental resistance. Participants are oriented through a series of obstacles designed to experience the limit on their borders. They can include climbing walls, heavy wearing objects, rope climbing, mud pits and fire. / Това са изтощителни състезания, които съчетават бягане за издръжливост, сила и психическа устойчивост. Участниците се ориентират през поредица от препятствия, предназначени да изпитат предела на техните граници. Те могат да включват стени за изкачване, тежки предмети за носене, катерене по въжета, кални ями и огън.

programme.title: Cycling: A Czech Tour / Колоездене: Обиколка на Чехия
programme.desc: The Sazka Tour is one of the most famous cycling competitions in the Czech Republic, which is usually held every year in the summer and attracts participants from all over the world. The event is part of the UCI Europe Tour, which makes it meaningful for professional cyclists, as well as for lovers who want to test their skills in this picturesque country. / "Sazka Tour" е едно от най-известните колоездачни състезания в Чехия, което обикновено се провежда всяка година през лятото и привлича участници от цял свят. Събитието е част от UCI Europe Tour, което го прави значимо за професионалните колоездачи, както и за любителите, които искат да изпитат своите умения в тази живописна страна.

programme.title: The latter wins / Последният печели
programme.desc: "The Last Win" is a fun-cognitive, family quiz show involving four players. It consists of three rounds with different spheres of knowledge, in which the questions are of different point value. After the end of each round, one participant drops out, and the winner wins the right to compete in the next episode and plays until someone else is able to beat him. / "Последният печели" е забавно-познавателно, семейно куиз шоу, в което участват четирима играчи. Състои се от три кръга с различни сфери на познанието, в които въпросите са с различна точкова стойност. След края на всеки кръг отпада по един участник, а победителят печели правото да се състезава и в следващия епизод и играе, докато някой друг не успее да го победи.

programme.title: Through the Time Corridors with Morgan Freeman / През коридорите на времето с Морган Фрийман
programme.desc: How can we accomplish complex tasks without consciously thinking about them and what is intuition? This reveals Morgan Freeman. / Как може да изпълняваме сложни задачи, без съзнателно да мислим за тях и какво е интуиция? Това разкрива Морган Фрийман.

programme.title: Sailing / Ветроходство: Гран при на Засниц
programme.desc: The Grand Prix is ​​a well -known sailing tournament that usually attracts many competitors and viewers with its high level and dramatic wind conditions. / Гран При на Засниц е известен ветроходен турнир, който обикновено привлича много състезатели и зрители със своето високо ниво и драматични условия на вятъра.

programme.title: I know that / Това го знам
programme.desc: The entertaining teenage quiz has the ambitious goal of providing viewers with a new view of the possibility of the learning material being presented in the public space through modern and interactive television games. Participants will have to overcome different challenges at every level of the game, gather lives, and especially have fun thanks to the knowledge they have gained at school. The format includes a variety of questions, logical tasks, music and a great deal of fun. All this is a gaming regulation of a video game style competition, combined with elements of the specifics of life on social networks. Participants in the children's educational program are 15 and 17 years old, and the project focuses on education as a fun process in the entertainment segment of television. / Забавно-образователната тийнейджърска викторина има амбициозната цел да предостави на зрителите нов поглед върху възможността учебният материал да бъде представен в публичното пространство чрез модерна и интерактивна телевизионна игра. Участниците ще трябва да преодоляват различни предизвикателства във всяко ниво от играта, да събират животи и най-вече да се забавляват благодарение на знанията, които са натрупали в училище. Форматът включва разнообразни въпроси, логически задачи, музика и голяма доза забавление. Всичко това е игрален регламент на състезание по знания в стилистиката на видео игра, съчетана с елементи от спецификите на живота в социалните мрежи. Участниците в детско-юношеското образователно предаване са на възраст межди 15 и 17 години, а проектът поставя фокус върху образованието като забавен процес в развлекателния сегмент на телевизионния ефир.

programme.desc: Represented by Morgan Freeman, the series "Through the Corridors of Time" explores the greatest mysteries of our existence - issues that puzzles humanity from all over eternity. Въпроси, върху които са размишлявали най-изтънчените умове на човешкия род. Днес науката се е развила до етап, при който конкретните факти и доказателства може би ще ни предоставят отговорите, измествайки философските теории. "През коридорите на времето" събира блестящи мислители и великолепни идеи от различни сфери на науката - астрофизиката, астробиологията, квантовата механика, струнната теория и други, за да ни разкрие удивителната истина за нашата Вселена.

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

Padom financijske moći talijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada. ...

The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Die Bewohner des Reiches oberhalb des Felsens und die von unterhalb durften sich nur zweimal im Jahr zu den Drachenfesten treffen, die im Fruhjahr und im Herbst zur Tag- und Nachtgleiche gefeiert wurden. Sie durften sich weder ineinander verlieben noch einander heiraten. Schuld daran war ein Fluch, den der einstmals unglucklich verliebte Drache ausgesprochen hatte: Junge Paare, die das Verbot missachteten, wurden in Vergissmeinnicht, tote Baumen oder Steine verwandelt.Ungluckseligerweise fuhlten sich - auf ihrem allerersten Fest - ausgerechnet Prinzessin Adelka aus dem unteren und Prinz Janko aus dem oberen Reich zueinander hingezogen. Trotz des gefahrlichen Fluches trafen sich die beiden heimlich - tief im Wald, damit niemand sie sah. Dabei entdeckten sie eine geheimnisvolle Hohle und machten Bekanntschaft mit ihrem Bewohner, dem Drachen. Mehr noch, sie verbrachten zusammen viel Zeit und freundeten sich allmahlich sogar mit ihm an.Eines Tages war ihr groSSer, starker Freund unendlich traurig. Der hinterhaltige Wurmschneck hatte das Drachenei, statt es zu behuten, in den Fluss fallen lassen. Nun wurde der Drache keine Nachkommen haben. Mutig rettete Prinz Janko, der ein guter Schwimmer war, das Ei aus dem kalten Wasser. Doch welch Ungluck! Der kleine Drachen, der aus dem Ei schlupfte, sah anders aus als alle anderen Drachen, er hatte zwei Kopfe. Adelka und Janko aber schlossen ihn sofort in ihr Herz. Und auch die beiden wurden immer unzertrennlicher. Um den Fluch aufzuheben, mussten sie ein Opfer bringen, das man von keinen Liebenden auf der ganzen Welt verlangen kann.

programme.title: Written off? - the east in the media / Abgeschrieben? - Der Osten in den Medien
programme.desc: In autumn 2024, on the anniversary of reunification and occasion of elections, the east is in the media focus. Even after the Bundestag election, the "special case of East Germany" again determines talks and headlines. A media picture of East Germany is paid fortery, which has solidified in the past 35 years. Negative headlines dominate the over-regional reporting. Example of sensitive media stories and scandals on East Germany shows the film how much today's image of East Germany was also characterized by the media. For this purpose, for example, the "picture" story about Joseph from Sebnitz, who was supposed to be murdered by Nazis, who died in a bathing accident, or the "Spiegel" story from the "billion-grave" and the title of the satire magazine "Titanic" to the most famous Ossi cliché: "Zonen-Gaby". The stylized photo was taken in a West German photo studio in November 1989, with a West German "Gaby". With Ki Uintage, it is made visible in the film, which image of East Germans is created when you evaluate the dip of the medially used attributions. Based on a systematic evaluation of thousands of press articles from the past decades, the AI ​​generates a surprisingly equal image of East Germans to this day: older people, often in the resistance ducture - on demonstrations, against construction lines or in a strangely lonely setting. Only in the 2000s you notice briefly a slight change - the "Ki -Osi" is young and laughs. The documentation analyzes with experts, journalists and portrayers, which media attributions were created when and how, what events they have shaped, and how they still work. And the film is what trust in classic media in the east has been subject to strong fluctuations over the past decades. Have their say u. Marieke Reimann, Hajo Schumacher, Rainald Grebe, Christoph Dieckmann, Anja Reich, Josa Mania-Schlegel, Hans Zippert, Mandy Troger and communication scientist who have researched media trust in East Germany. / Im Herbst 2024, zum Jahrestag der Wiedervereinigung und anlasslich von Wahlen, steht der Osten im medialen Fokus. Auch nach der Bundestagswahl bestimmt der "Sonderfall Ostdeutschland" wieder Talkrunden und Schlagzeilen. Es wird ein mediales Bild von Ostdeutschland forterzahlt, das sich in den letzten 35 Jahren verfestigt hat. Negativschlagzeilen dominieren die uberregionale Berichterstattung.Am Beispiel aufsehenerregender Medien-Stories und Skandale uber Ostdeutschland zeigt der Film, wie sehr das heutige Image Ostdeutschlands auch von den Medien gepragt wurde. Dazu zahlen etwa die "BILD"-Geschichte um den vermeintlich von Nazis ermordeten Joseph aus Sebnitz, der bei einem Badeunfall starb, oder die "Spiegel"-Story vom "Milliardengrab" sowie der Titel des Satire-Magazins "Titanic" zum heute wohl bekanntesten Ossi-Klischee: "Zonen-Gaby". Das stilisierte Foto entstand schon im November 1989 in einem westdeutschen Fotostudio, mit einer westdeutschen "Gaby".Mit KI-Unterstutzung wird im Film sichtbar gemacht, welches Bild von Ostdeutschen entsteht, wenn man die Haufigkeit der medial verwendeten Zuschreibungen auswertet. Auf Grundlage einer systematischen Auswertung tausender Presseartikel aus den letzten Jahrzehnten generiert die KI ein bis heute erstaunlich gleichformiges Image von Ostdeutschen: altere Menschen, oft im Widerstands-Duktus - auf Demonstrationen, vor baufalligen Hauserzeilen oder in seltsam einsamer Kulisse. Nur in den 2000er Jahren bemerkt man kurz eine leichte Veranderung - der "KI-Ossi" ist junger und lachelt.Die Dokumentation analysiert mit Expertinnen und Experten, Journalisten und Portratierten, welche medialen Zuschreibungen wann und wie entstanden sind, welche Ereignisse sie gepragt haben, und erortert, wie sie bis heute wirken. Und der Film erzahlt, warum gerade im Osten das Vertrauen in klassische Medien im Laufe der letzten Jahrzehnte immer wieder starken Schwankungen unterliegt. Zu Wort kommen u. a. Marieke Reimann, Hajo Schumacher, Rainald Grebe, Christoph Dieckmann, Anja Reich, Josa Mania-Schlegel, Hans Zippert, Mandy Troger sowie Kommunikationswissenschaftler, die zum Medienvertrauen in Ostdeutschland geforscht haben.

programme.title: Kabarettgipfel
programme.desc: Once it was ... not only Marchen start, but also this Marchen -like cabaret summit. Was everything really better? No, Gernot Kulis thinks, you have to go over time. The modern technology is a blessing and definitely not a curse. From day to day, his speaking washing machine, the clever ice box and above all his vacuum robot "suction" grow more. And once it was the little Lydia Prenner-Kasper who didn't want to grow up. With a pure childlike heart, she is on the side of her children at the parenting day with a pointed tongue. Andreas Vitásek reflects his origin and takes us back to favorites. In the district of his childhood, he gets a hazelnuss ice cream at Reumannplatz, hits old friends from the football cafig and is looking for a host at the Searchwirtplatz. Some nostalgia of the past melts like the ice in the sun. Return in the present, Sonja Pikart clears up false myths. No, we don't just use 10% of our brain. Yes, it is possible that the thick bumblebee can fly. And she also knows why artificial intelligence will never be the same for people: we are simply too quirky. What Martin Frank is really shouting is that we humanize our pets. These fashion cats go completely too far without fur. Then he feels pity, because they are bullied in the neighborhood at the farm. / Es war einmal ...So beginnen nicht nur Marchen, sondern auch dieser marchenhafte Kabarettgipfel. War fruher wirklich alles besser? Nein, denkt sich Gernot Kulis, man muss mit der Zeit gehen. Die moderne Technik ist da ein Segen und bestimmt kein Fluch. Von Tag zu Tag wachsen ihm seine sprechende Waschmaschine, der kluge Eiskasten und vor allem sein Saugroboter "Saugustin" mehr ans Herz. Und es war einmal die kleine Lydia Prenner-Kasper, die wollte nicht erwachsen werden. Mit einem reinen kindlichen Herzen steht sie beim Elternsprechtag mit spitzer Zunge auf der Seite ihrer Kinder. Andreas Vitásek besinnt sich seiner Herkunft und nimmt uns mit zuruck nach Favoriten. Im Bezirk seiner Kindheit holt er sich am Reumannplatz ein Haselnusseis, trifft alte Freunde aus dem FuSSballkafig und sucht am Suchenwirtplatz einen Wirten. Manche Nostalgie der Vergangenheit schmilzt da wie das Eis in der Sonne. Zuruck in der Gegenwart raumt Sonja Pikart mit falschen Mythen auf. Nein, wir benutzen nicht nur 10% unseres Gehirns. Ja, es ist moglich, dass die dicke Hummel fliegen kann. Und sie weiSS auch, warum die Kunstliche Intelligenz niemals dem Menschen gleich sein wird: Wir sind einfach zu schrullig. Was Martin Frank an Menschen wirklich schrag findet, ist, dass wir unsere Haustiere vermenschlichen. Vollig zu weit gehen ihm diese Mode-Katzen ohne Fell. Da hat er Mitleid, denn die werden in der Nachbarschaft am Bauernhof gemobbt.Musikalisch begleitet werden die Kabarettistinnen und Kabarettisten wieder von der All-Female-Formation "KGB - Die Kabarettgipfelband".

programme.title: Do you want to go with me? / Willst Du mit mir gehen?
programme.desc: Where, if not on the "romantic Brundlweg" on the pogusch, can you find your great love? This time Single Lukas is looking for his dream woman. Three women want to win his heart. Content manager Marietta or Lukas herself? Finally, the Tyrolean Helene, a surprise candidate who prepared a very special speed date for Lukas, causes a stir. programme.desc: Socrates got up too late: now his fruke is cold and he doesn't find his Kappi! Leo also gets up too late again and sees that his friend Justus is leaving the house. programme.title: Erlebnis Österreich
programme.sub-title: Hof Castle - Prince Eugen builds his dream / Schloss Hof - Prinz Eugen baut seinen Traum
programme.desc: He was the greatest of his time. He was one of the richest men of his time. And he was one of the greatest art collectors of his time. Prince Eugen of Savoy-Carignan acquired the 40 kilometers of Vienna in 1725 and began to transform the original Renaissance castle into a baroque palace complex. With the most basic planners, architects, garden designers and furniture designers - this was how it was described today. This "Experience Austria" from the ORF Landesstudio Niederosterreich (design: Barbara Baldauf, camera: Franz Cee) sets out for the trace of traces of the man Prince Eugen, tries to scrape his passions, to illuminate his facilities and to recognize his grade. Fur Prince Eugen was nothing too expensive and seemingly nothing good enough. His winter palace and the Belvedere in Vienna still pay to the most impressive baroque buildings in the Esterreich capital. He wanted to continue realizing his dreams in Hof Castle and he managed to calm down in a age in which others have long calmed down. When Prince Eugen Schloss Hof acquired Hof, he was 62 years old. He commissioned the architect Johann Lucas von Hildebrandt to build a repressant hunting seat from the lucky Renaissance kastell with a rectangular floor plan. So a building was built on the landing of Castle Hof in a short time that no wish left open. The castle was delivered to the west around two flight buildings. Until the death of Prince Eugens, over 800 craftsmen were also bustled with seven terraces. For the exquisite equipment of the palace rooms - on the first floor there were Prince Eugen's residential apartment, the parade apartment, 13 guest room, the chapel and the ballroom - those artists who had already earned in the Belvedere castle were already involved. Among them were the interior decorator Claude Le Fort Du Plessy and the plasterers Santino Bussi and Alberto Camesina. A special exhibition is dedicated to the 300-year existence of Hof in the Baroque Castle Hof and also in the Lower Weiden Castle in his design by Prince Eugen. The "Eugen behind the Prince" is also illuminated. The rapid rise of Eugen as a general and war minister, the many facets of the brilliant networker and manic collector, his role at the center of an elite group of friends and arts and the prompt shape of the Esterreichian baroque. How did the prince get to all the exotic plants and animals, to the exquisite fabrics and ceramics, where does his thousands of bookers come from, what drove him to deal with philosophy? In 1736, Prince Eugen died in the 73rd year of life childless before the final completion of his Castle Hof, his inheritance is now accessible to all visitor of the impressive castle. / Er war der groSSte Kriegsheld seiner Zeit. Er war einer der reichsten Manner seiner Zeit. Und er war einer der groSSten Kunstsammler seiner Zeit. Prinz Eugen von Savoyen-Carignan erwarb 1725 die 40 Kilometer ostlich von Wien gelegene Herrschaft Hof und begann das ursprungliche Renaissance-Kastell zu einer barocken Schlossanlage umzugestalten. Mit den beruhmtesten Planern, Architekten, Gartengestaltern und Mobeldesignern - so wurde man das heute bezeichnen. Dieses "Erlebnis Österreich" aus dem ORF Landesstudio Niederosterreich (Gestaltung: Barbara Baldauf, Kamera: Franz Cee) macht sich auf die Spurensuche nach dem Mann Prinz Eugen, versucht seine Leidenschaften zu ergrunden, seine Fahigkeiten zu beleuchten und seine Note zu erkennen.Fur Prinz Eugen war nichts zu teuer und scheinbar auch nichts gut genug. Sein Winterpalais und das Belvedere in Wien zahlen bis heute zu den beeindruckendsten Barockbauten der osterreichischen Hauptstadt. In Schloss Hof wollte er seine Traume weiter verwirklichen und es gelang ihm in einem Lebensalter, in dem sich andere langst zur Ruhe gesetzt haben. Als Prinz Eugen Schloss Hof erwarb, war er 62 Jahre alt. Er beauftragte den Architekten Johann Lucas von Hildebrandt aus dem einstockigen Renaissancekastell mit rechteckigem Grundriss einen reprasentativen Jagdsitz zu errichten. So entstand am Gelande von Schloss Hof in kurzester Zeit ein Gebaude, das keine Wunsche offenlieSS. Das Schloss wurde um zwei Flugelbauten nach Westen hin verlangert. Über 800 Handwerker waren bis zum Tode Prinz Eugens unter anderem auch damit beschaftigt, einen weitlaufigen Garten mit sieben Terrassen anzulegen. Fur die exquisite Ausstattung der Schlossraume - im ersten Stock befanden sich Prinz Eugens Wohnappartement, das Paradeappartement, 13 Gastezimmer, die Kapelle und der Festsaal - wurden jene Kunstler engagiert, die sich bereits unter anderem in den Belvedere Schlossern verdient gemacht hatten. Darunter waren der Innendekorateur Claude Le Fort du Plessy sowie die Stuckateure Santino Bussi und Alberto Camesina.Eine Sonderausstellung widmet sich im barocken Schloss Hof und auch im Schloss Niederweiden dem 300-jahrigen Bestehen von Schloss Hof in seiner Gestaltung durch Prinz Eugen. Dabei wird auch der "Eugen hinter dem Prinzen" beleuchtet. Der rasante Aufstieg Eugens als Feldherr und Kriegsminister, die vielen Facetten des brillanten Netzwerkers und manischen Sammlers, seine Rolle im Mittelpunkt eines elitaren Freundes- und Kunstlerkreises und die pragende Gestalt des osterreichischen Barocks. Wie kam der Prinz zu all den exotischen Pflanzen und Tieren, zu den erlesenen Stoffen und Keramiken, woher stammt seine tausende Bucher umfassende Bibliothek, was trieb ihn an, sich mit Philosophie zu beschaftigen?1736 stirbt Prinz Eugen im 73. Lebensjahr kinderlos noch vor der endgultigen Vollendung seines Schloss Hof Traums, sein Erbe ist heute allen Besuchern der beeindruckenden Schlossanlage zuganglich.

programme.title: Natur im Garten
programme.desc: Karl Ploberger presents a garden paradise in the Waldviertel, prepares the garden for autumn and Krauterhexe Uschi Zezelitsch devotes himself to the Goldrute.Berta Scherzer has created an 8000m² show garden in Schrems. Prythate perennial beds, a large swimming pond and natural elements that are harmoniously integrated into the landscape, make the garden an oasis of calm. From high summer it often goes directly into autumn and in places with tons of rain. What this means for the plants and how to get the garden fit again - Karl Ploberger knows what to do. With Uschi Zezelitsch, everything is about the goldenrod today. The Krauterhexe does not prize a classic recipe, but a "all in one" tip, how to best use the healed powers of the plant. In bare spots, special seeds are sprinkled to get the biodiversity. Prachtige Staudenbeete, ein groSSer Schwimmteich und naturliche Elemente, die harmonisch in die Landschaft integriert sind, machen den Garten zu einer Oase der Ruhe.Vom Hochsommer gehts oft direkt in den Herbst und das stellenweise mit Unmengen an Regen. programme.title: Österreich-Bild aus dem Landesstudio Vorarlberg
programme.sub-title: Save - Guardi - Lost - Bergen - 150 years of the Vorarlberg State Fire Brigade Association / Retten - Schutzen - Loschen - Bergen - 150 Jahre Landesfeuerwehrverband Vorarlberg
programme.desc: The first fire departments were founded in Vorarlberg in the mid -19th century. At that time it was primarily young men from gymnastics clubs who organized themselves to save people and fire. In order to develop and distribute the power, the "Vorarlberg Feuerwehrgauverband" was founded in 1875 to bundle and distribute them. This gradually developed from the "State Fire Brigade Association of Vorarlberg", which is now the hub for fire brigade in the country. The documentation of the ORF Vorarlberg illuminates the tasks of the State Fire Brigade Association and the training center in Feldkirch then and now. / In Vorarlberg wurden die ersten Feuerwehren Mitte des 19. Jahrhunderts gegrundet. Damals waren es in erster Linie junge Manner aus Turnvereinen, die sich organisierten, um Menschen zu retten und Brande zu loschen. Um die Krafte zu bundeln, Erfahrungen auszutauschen und Ausrustungen zu entwickeln und zu verteilen, wurde 1875 der "Vorarlberger Feuerwehrgauverband" gegrundet. Aus diesem entwickelte sich nach und nach der "Landesfeuerwehrverband Vorarlberg", der heute die Drehscheibe fur das Feuerwehrwesen im Land ist. Die Dokumentation des ORF Vorarlberg beleuchtet die Aufgaben des Landesfeuerwehrverbandes sowie das Ausbildungszentrum in Feldkirch damals und heute.

programme.title: WeltWeit
programme.sub-title: Exit strategy. Where do you still live? / Exit-Strategie. Wo lasst es sich noch leben?
programme.desc: Expensive rents, enormously high cost of living due to the increasing inflation and on top of that, a founded uncertainty, drawn by numerous global crises: from wars on climate change to the situation in the United States, which has become increasingly unpredictable since Donald Trump took office. The "worldwide" reporters: Inside, people have looked at how people adapt to the challenges and which exit strategies work. In the USA - as is so often - it can be directed. From the nuclear disaster to a burger war scenario in the country, when billionaires think about exit strategies, it is not about canned goods in the basement, but about underground luxury villas with home cinema, high-tech filters and gun barriers. Christophe Kohl immerses in the secret world of the bunker industry in Texas for his report. Ron Hubbard, the founder of "Atlas Survival Shelters", presents him with an exclusive insight into his company, which builds the shelter of all kinds for the rich in this world. Creating a high quality of life for all residents is at the top of the government's agenda in Singapore. The Sudostasian metropolis grows due to its exposed location on the Sudspitze of the Malay Peninsula Uber hardly any natural water sources and is 90 percent dependent on food imports. This creates a high level of uncertainty and the small country wants to reduce it. Isabella Purkart looks at how urban farms on high -rise roofers and projects such as "Edible Garden City" transform unused flat in the garden and revolutionize innovative approaches. Panama pays to the most modern countries of Latin America and has now become a popular residence for foreign pensioners abroad. Nicole Kampl has visited a law firm that specializes in German -speaking people who are like to emigrate. The inquiries are becoming more and more, because in addition to its stable economy and a good health system, Panama scores primarily with the so-called "pensionado visa": "It enables large-scale tax relief, discounts in restaurants as well as in doctors and in pharmacies," says Kimberly Kelley. The American has been living on the Pacific Custody for two years and is happily because she can afford a life here according to her taste. / Teure Mieten, enorm hohe Lebenshaltungskosten durch die steigende Inflation und obendrauf eine gefuhlte Unsicherheit, ausgelost durch zahlreiche globale Krisen: von Kriegen uber Klimawandel bis zur Situation in den USA, die seit Amtsantritt von Donald Trump zunehmend unvorhersehbar wird. Die "WeltWeit"- Reporter:innen haben sich angeschaut, wie sich Menschen auf die Herausforderungen einstellen, und welche Exit-Strategien funktionieren.In den USA zeigt sich - wie so oft -, wer Geld hat, kann es sich richten. Von der atomaren Katastrophe bis zu einem Burgerkriegs-Szenario im Land, wenn Milliardare uber Exit-Strategien nachdenken, dann geht es nicht um Konserven im Keller, sondern um unterirdische Luxusvillen mit Heimkino, Hightech-Luftfiltern und Waffenschranken. Christophe Kohl taucht fur seine Reportage ein in die geheime Welt der Bunkerindustrie in Texas. Ron Hubbard, Grunder von "Atlas Survival Shelters", gewahrt ihm einen exklusiven Einblick in sein Unternehmen, das Schutzraume aller Art fur die Reichen dieser Welt baut.Eine hohe Lebensqualitat fur alle Bewohnerinnen und Bewohner zu schaffen, steht ganz oben auf der Agenda der Regierung in Singapur. Die sudostasiatische Metropole verfugt aufgrund ihrer exponierten Lage an der Sudspitze der Malaiischen Halbinsel uber kaum naturliche Wasserquellen und ist zu 90 Prozent auf Lebensmittelimporte angewiesen. Das schafft eine hohe Unsicherheit und die will das kleine Land verringern. Isabella Purkart schaut sich an, wie urbane Farmen auf Hochhausdachern und Projekte wie "Edible Garden City" ungenutzte Flachen in Garten verwandeln und innovative Ansatze die Wasserversorgung revolutionieren.Panama zahlt zu den modernsten Landern Lateinamerikas und ist mittlerweile ein beliebter Alterswohnsitz fur auslandische Pensionistinnen und Pensionisten geworden. Nicole Kampl hat eine Kanzlei besucht, die sich auf deutschsprachige Auswanderungswillige spezialisiert hat. Die Anfragen werden immer mehr, denn Panama punktet neben seiner stabilen Wirtschaft und einem guten Gesundheitssystem vor allem mit dem sogenannten "Pensionado-Visum": "Es ermoglicht groSSzugige Steuererleichterungen, Rabatte in Restaurants sowie bei Ärzten und in Apotheken", erzahlt Kimberly Kelley. Die US-Amerikanerin lebt seit zwei Jahren an der Pazifikkuste und ist glucklich, weil sie sich hier ein Leben ganz nach ihrem Geschmack leisten kann.

Isabella Purkart schaut sich an, wie urbane Farmen auf Hochhausdachern und Projekte wie "Edible Garden City" ungenutzte Flachen in Garten verwandeln und innovative Ansatze die Wasserversorgung revolutionieren.Panama zahlt zu den modernsten Landern Lateinamerikas und ist mittlerweile ein beliebter Alterswohnsitz fur auslandische Pensionistinnen und Pensionisten geworden. Nicole Kampl hat eine Kanzlei besucht, die sich auf deutschsprachige Auswanderungswillige spezialisiert hat. Die Anfragen werden immer mehr, denn Panama punktet neben seiner stabilen Wirtschaft und einem guten Gesundheitssystem vor allem mit dem sogenannten "Pensionado-Visum": "Es ermoglicht groSSzugige Steuererleichterungen, Rabatte in Restaurants sowie bei Ärzten und in Apotheken", erzahlt Kimberly Kelley. Die US-Amerikanerin lebt seit zwei Jahren an der Pazifikkuste und ist glucklich, weil sie sich hier ein Leben ganz nach ihrem Geschmack leisten kann.

programme.title: A Habsburg on Mallorca - Ludwig Salvator and the magic of the sea / Ein Habsburger auf Mallorca - Ludwig Salvator und der Zauber des Meeres
programme.desc: Ludwig Salvator, Archduke of Austria and Prince of Tuscany, traveled and researched the Mediterranean with his sailing yacht for decades and finally settled in Mallorca.* His special interest was the research of unknown islands at the time, from the country and people, flora and fauna. He documented his trips in words and pictures. Magnificent Bucher testify to his universal work.*Archduke Ludwig Salvator von Habsburg-Lorraine and Bourbon (4.8.1847-12.10.1915) was an unpleasant, a universal genius, an dropout and nature conservationist from the very beginning. However, he was not only a fun -loving globetrotter, but also a recognized researcher of the Mediterranean, especially the Balearic Islands. He has recorded his research results on history, flora and fauna in extensive publications. The documentation shows the most important life stations of Ludwig Salvator and the sustainable effects of his research activity in the late 19th century. Throughout his life, he was driven by the desire to travel, understand and preserve. As the owner of the steam yacht "mermaid" and the "capitan spatent of the long journey", he was in the Mediterranean for decades to awaken the interest of the public for the regions that were largely unknown at the time, such as the Liparic Islands and the Ionian protective of the Balearic and the loveliness of their inhabitants particularly impressed the archduke. He created a small paradise in the northwest of Mallorca, where no animal was tired and no tree was allowed to be. For his monumental work "The Balearic Islands. Described in word and picture" he received the gold medal at the Paris World Exhibition in 1889.Annatuigent legends and anecdotes rose around the "uncrowned king of the Balearic Islands". He neither grief about the appearance that was expected by a member of the Habsburg family, nor about what others thought about him. Because of his scraping clothes, he was kept for a shepherd or farm worker - to his great amusement. He commented calmly that he was considered a scholarly nerd at Hof: "Better diverse than simple". Ludwig Salvator's love life was turbulent. The bachelor is said to have been to both sexes and have had countless affarities. He supposedly took care of his illegitimate children. One of his love affairs, Catalina Homar, the daughter of a carpenter, let the Archduke give an excellent training and finally made them the administrator of his vineyard. Ludwig Salvator was a scientist, artist, visionary, pacifist, nature conservation, writer and one of the most dazzling people from Habsburg. / Ludwig Salvator, Erzherzog von Österreich und Prinz von Toskana, bereiste und erforschte jahrzehntelang mit seiner Segelyacht "Nixe" das Mittelmeer und lieSS sich schlieSSlich auf Mallorca nieder.*Er war gebildet, unangepasst und aufgeschlossen. Sein besonderes Interesse galt der Erforschung damals unbekannter Inseln, von Land und Leuten, Flora und Fauna. Seine Reisen dokumentierte er in Wort und Bild. Prachtvolle Bucher bezeugen sein universelles Schaffen.*Erzherzog Ludwig Salvator von Habsburg-Lothringen und Bourbon (4.8.1847-12.10.1915) war ein Unangepasster, ein Universalgenie, ein Aussteiger und Natur-schutzer der ersten Stunde. Er war aber nicht nur ein lebenslustiger Globetrotter, sondern auch ein anerkannter Forscher des Mittelmeerraumes, besonders der Balearen. Seine Forschungsergebnisse uber Geschichte, Tier- und Pflanzenwelt hat er in umfangreichen Publikationen festgehalten.Die Dokumentation zeigt die wichtigsten Lebensstationen Ludwig Salvators und die nachhaltigen Auswirkungen seiner Forschertatigkeit im ausgehenden 19. Jahrhundert. Zeit seines Lebens war er getrieben von dem Verlangen zu reisen, zu verstehen und zu bewahren. Als Besitzer der Dampfsegelyacht "Nixe" und des "Kapitanspatentes der langen Fahrt" war er jahrzehntelang im Mittelmeer unterwegs, um das Interesse der Öffentlichkeit fur damals weitgehend unbekannte Regionen zu wecken, wie die Liparischen Inseln und die Ionischen Inseln.Die wilde Schonheit der Balearen und die Liebenswurdigkeit von deren Bewohnern beeindruckten den Erzherzog besonders. Er schuf sich im Nordwesten Mallorcas ein kleines Paradies, wo kein Tier getotet und kein Baum gefallt werden durfte. Fur sein Monumentalwerk "Die Balearen. Geschildert in Wort und Bild" erhielt er auf der Pariser Weltausstellung 1889 die Goldmedaille.Unzahlige Legenden und Anekdoten ranken sich um den "ungekronten Konig der Balearen". Er kummerte sich weder um das Auftreten, das von einem Mitglied der Familie Habsburg erwartet wurde, noch darum, was andere uber ihn dachten. Seiner schabigen Kleidung wegen wurde er immer wieder fur einen Schafhirten oder Landarbeiter gehalten - zu seiner groSSen Belustigung. Dass er bei Hof als gelehrter Sonderling galt, kommentierte er gelassen: "Lieber vielfaltig als einfaltig".Ludwig Salvators Liebesleben war turbulent. Der Junggeselle soll beiden Geschlechtern zugetan gewesen sein und zahllose Affaren gehabt haben. Fur seine unehelichen Kinder hat er angeblich gut gesorgt. Einer seiner Liebschaften, Catalina Homar, der Tochter eines Tischlers, lieSS der Erzherzog eine exzellente Ausbildung angedeihen und machte sie schlieSSlich sogar zur Verwalterin seiner Weinguter.Ludwig Salvator war Wissenschaftler, Kunstler, Visionar, Pazifist, Naturschutzer, Schriftsteller und eine der schillerndsten Personlichkeiten aus dem Hause Habsburg.Eine Dokumentation von Rosa Maria Plattner
