programme.title: Košarka - Aba League: Igokea - Fmp / Košarka - ABA liga: Igokea - FMP
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Oni vole Srbiju
programme.desc: The number of players and coaches who found its happiness in Serbia is not small. They belong to different branches of sports, and they could have been convinced here how true the famous Serbian hospitality stories are true. Some of them found the love of your life here, found homes, friends for all life, get citizenship. What is their attitude towards Serbia and what their life is, find out in our show. / Broj igrača i trenera koji je svoju sreću pronašao u Srbiji nije mali. Oni pripadaju različitim granama sporta, a ovde su mogli da se uvere koliko su priče o čuvenom srpskom gostoprimstvu istinite. Neki od njih su ovde pronašli ljubav svog života, pronašli kumove, prijatelje za ceo život, dobili državljanstvo. Kakav je njihov odnos prema Srbiji i kakav je njihov život, saznajte u našoj emisiji.

programme.title: Football - Champions League: Multiprenos / Fudbal - Liga šampiona: Multiprenos
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, the annual continental competition in which only the champions of their states are performed. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of its state. The Champions League finals became a television the most watched football event on the planet. The most conquered titles of the Champions of Europe has Madrid Giant Real. / Na predlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga šampiona, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Evrope. Plasman u Ligu šampiona klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom na ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige šampiona postalo je televizijski najgledaniji fudbalski događaj na planeti. Najviše osvojenih titula prvaka Evrope ima madridski velikan Real.

programme.title: Football - Europa League: Multiprenos / Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Multiprenos
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was a cup of fair cities that played since 1955. until 1971. years. From that season, the competition is officially called the UEFA Cup and is under that name until 2009. when it was renamed to the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format itself changed several times, and from the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which the elimination follow. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972. for the UEFA Cup final by the Italian artist Bertoni and each year is awarded to the winner who keeps him a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog takmičenja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone takmičenje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Evrope. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobednika ovog takmičenja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane italijanskog umetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodeljuje pobedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Viktoria Plzen - Malmo
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was a cup of fair cities that played since 1955. until 1971. years. From that season, the competition is officially called the UEFA Cup and is under that name until 2009. when it was renamed to the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format itself changed several times, and from the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which the elimination follow. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972. for the UEFA Cup final by the Italian artist Bertoni and each year is awarded to the winner who keeps him a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog takmičenja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone takmičenje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Evrope. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobednika ovog takmičenja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane italijanskog umetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodeljuje pobedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Košarka - Euroleague: EFES - Hapoel Tel Aviv / Košarka - Euroleague: Efes - Hapoel Tel Aviv
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Vienna - Illyria / Košarka - ABA liga: Vienna - Ilirija
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. programme.title: Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Utrecht - Lyon
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was a cup of fair cities that played since 1955. until 1971. years. From that season, the competition is officially called the UEFA Cup and is under that name until 2009. when it was renamed to the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format itself changed several times, and from the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which the elimination follow. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972. for the UEFA Cup final by the Italian artist Bertoni and each year is awarded to the winner who keeps him a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog takmičenja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone takmičenje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Evrope. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobednika ovog takmičenja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane italijanskog umetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodeljuje pobedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. programme.title: Košarka - Euroleague: EFES - MACCABI Tel Aviv / Košarka - Euroleague: Efes - Maccabi Tel Aviv
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. programme.title: Košarka - Kls: Tamiš - Dynamic / Košarka - KLS: Tamiš - Dynamic
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the subcircular point system and in mutual meetings each club hosts one time and by one guest. It is interesting in this part of the competition, Serbian clubs playing in this part of the competition, which play the regional ABA league. After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Super League depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but in that part of the competition, there are always 8 teams. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Sama liga osnovana je 2006. godine i kao takva broji 14 timova. Takmičenje se odvija po dvokružnom bod sistemu te je u međusobnim susretima svaki klub jedan put domaćin i po jednom gost. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

And while Avitabile remains in prison for another year, Genny must rule over the northern Naples and Rome. Ciro will avenge, but his dreams and family are destroyed. / Když je kmotr Don Pietro zavražděn, je třeba zaplnit jeho místo v neapolskem podsvětí. Vládu převezme jeho syn Genry, který tak využije příležitosti srovnat stare účty. Přeživší ostatních rozkolů, kteří jsou vyčerpáni válčením a obrovským tlakem ze strany policie, utrpěli drasticke finanční ztráty a nastolili mír. A zatímco Avitabile zůstává ve vězení další rok, Genny musí vládnout nad severní Neapolí a Římem. Ciro se sice pomstí, ale jeho sny a rodina jsou zničeny.

programme.title: MMA (M): Lightweight, UFC
programme.desc: Join and follow many exciting events of mixed martial arts that take place around the world. Mixed martial arts or MMA are a contact martial arts that combines techniques from various martial arts and martial arts such as boxing, wrestling, judo, Jujitsu, karate, Thai boxing and others. / Pridružite se in spremljajte številne razburljive dogodke mešanih borilnih veščin, ki potekajo po vsem svetu. The Berliners won the trophy for the first time last year with a reliable 3-0 victory against VFB Friedrichshafen. Unlike the previous years, the Super Cup for women and men is not going together this year. SSC Palmberg Schwerin and Dresdner SC played their match at the end of September. / Mojstrice iz Schwerina se bodo v Superpokalu pomerile z zmagovalkami DVV-pokala. Potem ko je več igralk zapustilo klub – med njimi zvezdnica lige Elles Dambrink – je kapetanka ekipe Annegret Holzig pomembnejša kot kdajkoli prej.Po predčasni prekinitvi odbojkarske Bundeslige zaradi koronavirusa je comdirect Supercup kot prvi vrhunec nove sezone znova prinesel vrhunsko odbojko v živo na SPORT1. Na moškem Superpokalu v Frankfurtu se danes pomerita United Volleys Frankfurt in BERLIN RECYCLING Volleys. Berlinčani so si lani prvič priborili pokal z zanesljivo zmago 3:0 proti VfB Friedrichshafen. Za razliko od prejšnjih let Superpokal za ženske in moške letos ne poteka skupaj. programme.title: Football (M): Celje - Maribor, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Celje - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Celje - Maribor, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Celje - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: To nicer: Rescue of fish and cave Karlovica, Mon. / Na lepše: Reševanje rib in jama Karlovica, pon.
programme.desc: Did you know that the Inner people are also a maritime nation? The team of the program on a nicer one was present in the early morning in the rescue of fish on the largest intermittent lake in Europe. Rescue is also important because of the survival of birds that feed on a fish life, as half of the European bird population nests near Cerknica Lake. Polihistor Janez Vajkart Valvazor had already reported the rescue and hunting of fish, who recorded that the Inner people were picking up the fish from the lake naked. The team on the nicer, together with Jamar, also went to the cave system of Mala and Velika Karlovica, where the largest amount of the flooded lake flows. Both caves are part of the Ljubljanica underground system, which is considered to be the river of seven names. / Ste vedeli, da so Notranjci tudi pomorski narod? Ekipa oddaje Na lepše je bila v zgodnji jutranjih urah prisotna pri reševanju rib na največjem presihajočem jezeru v Evropi. Reševanje je pomembno tudi zaradi preživetja ptic, ki se hranijo z ribjim življem, saj ob Cerkniškem jezeru gnezdi kar polovica evropske populacije ptic. O reševanju in tudi lovljenju rib pa je poročal že polihistor Janez Vajkart Valvazor, ki je zabeležil, da so Notranjci njega dni, ribe iz jezera pobiral kar goli. Ekipa Na lepše pa se je skupaj z jamarjem odpravila tudi v jamski sistem Male in Velike Karlovice, jam kamor se steka največja količina naplavljenega jezera. Obe jami pa predstavljata del podzemnega sistema Ljubljanice, ki velja za reko Sedmerih imen.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: The lady in yellow (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American yellow show, with the participation of Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. He aired weekly on the CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV-Movie, until 2003 (as a wagon read with murder, the ballad of the lost boy and appointment with death). Angela Lansbury played the role of executive producer of the show in his last seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspective writer of yellow, who often finds himself dealing with mysterious murders, for whom he always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small village, the fictitious Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of La Signora in Yellow is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the first choice of the manufacturer. The part had been initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however refused. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.desc: To the thief! - by Joe Pieracci and Gioele Di Stefano the broken door. Lampting soda. Jewels, valuable objects and memories disappeared forever. There who, returning home, found themselves in front of this shocking show. Who even, while at night the thieves rummaged in the drawers and in the jewels, slept not far away, in his bed, and the awakening was traumatic. And then there is those who simply left the window a little open: and so much is enough because the hand of a furfante extends inside the town. In recent times, it happens more and more often in Ticino: within a year, the thefts in homes have gone from 519 to 678, those in cars from 405 to 788. Of course: if we look away ten years ago, things have however improved. And not a little. But when citizens find themselves living in areas or neighborhoods targeted by thieves, there are no statistics that keep: the fear, anger, the sense of abandonment prevails. And the case of some buildings in Pregassona, which in a few months have been visited several times by the thieves. Indeed, from the thieves as demonstrated by the videos of the surveillance cameras, who immortalized the band of young women alloperation. Images that surprise, frightened, and that sometimes go around the web: on social media the videos of thieves surprised to steal in Italian Switzerland are different, and are shared alleviated, spreading other anger and new concerns. And then, the protest grows and the questions multiply: how to defend yourself? And what does the police do? To try to give answers, Patti Chiari has sifted through the statistics of the thefts and followed the cantonal police in his work: between patrols, alarms and chases. And then we collected the testimonies of the victims of the thefts: the discovery, the fright, the trauma that does not make the night sleep, and sometimes it is not erased even after years. / Al ladro! - di Joe Pieracci e Gioele Di Stefano La porta sfondata. Lappartamento messo a soqquadro. Gioielli, oggetti di valore e ricordi spariti per sempre. Cè chi, rientrando a casa, si è trovato davanti questo scioccante spettacolo. Chi addirittura, mentre di notte i ladri frugavano nei cassetti e nei portagioie, dormiva poco lontano, nel proprio letto, e il risveglio è stato traumatico. E poi cè chi, semplicemente, ha lasciato magari il finestrino dellauto un po aperto: e tanto basta perche la mano di un furfante si allunghi allinterno dellabitacolo. Negli ultimi tempi, succede sempre più spesso in Ticino: nel giro di un anno, i furti nelle abitazioni sono passati da 519 a 678, quelli nelle automobili da 405 a 788. Certo: se allunghiamo lo sguardo a dieci anni fa, le cose sono comunque migliorate. E non di poco. Ma quando i cittadini si trovano a vivere in zone o quartieri presi di mira dai ladri, non ci sono statistiche che tengano: a prevalere è la paura, la rabbia, il senso di abbandono. E il caso di alcune palazzine a Pregassona, che nellarco di pochi mesi sono state visitate più volte dai ladri. Anzi, dalle ladre come dimostrano i video delle telecamere di sorveglianza, che hanno immortalato la banda di giovani donne allopera. Immagini che sorprendono, spaventano, e che a volte fanno il giro del web: sui social i video di ladri sorpresi a rubare nella Svizzera italiana sono diversi, e vengono condivisi allimpazzata, diffondendo altra rabbia e nuove preoccupazioni. E allora, cresce la protesta e si moltiplicano le domande: come difendersi? E che cosa fa la polizia? Per tentare di dare delle risposte, Patti chiari ha spulciato nelle statistiche dei furti e ha seguito la polizia cantonale nel suo lavoro: tra pattugliamenti, allarmi e inseguimenti. E poi abbiamo raccolto le testimonianze delle vittime dei furti: la scoperta, lo spavento, il trauma che non fa dormire la notte, e a volte non si cancella nemmeno dopo anni.

programme.title: World Treasures - Spain: Avila / Tesori del mondo - Spagna: Avila
programme.desc: Let's protect them. Let's not lose them. We know them. A series that punctures the RSI schedule makes us know the great treasures of the planet that hosts us.ávila is a Spanish city, provincial capital in the Castile and Leon region. Sumifying at 1,131 m. On the sea level, in a rocky area on the right bank of the Adaja river, a tributary of Duero, it turns out to be the highest provincial capital in Spain. The territory of the municipality extends for 231.9 km2. is a bishopric and is universally known because birthplace of one of the greatest holes of Catholicism: Teresa Davila.The history of ávila begins in legend: according to the mythology Abyla was the wife of Ercole from whom she had a son called Alcideo who would have conquered the Iberian peninsula and founded a city to which he imposed the name of his mother. In fact, it is known from the vestigia found that the Avila area was inhabited in the seventh century BC. From a Celtic population, the vetons, who called it obilated. In 237 BC Amilcare Barca supplied soldiers for his army by making a military leverage of the young people of Avila. The Romans installed a military camp forcing the vetoons to abandon the city. / Proteggiamoli. Non perdiamoli. Conosciamoli. Una serie che punteggia il palinsesto RSI ci fa conoscere i grandi tesori del pianeta che ci ospita.Ávila è una città spagnola, capoluogo di Provincia nella regione di Castiglia e Leon. Sorgendo a 1.131 m. sul livello del mare, in una zona rocciosa sulla sponda destra del fiume Adaja, affluente del Duero, risulta essere il capoluogo di provincia più alto della Spagna. Il territorio del comune si estende per 231,9 km2.È sede vescovile ed è universalmente nota perche città natale di una fra le più grandi sante del cattolicesimo: Teresa dAvila.La storia di Ávila inizia nella leggenda: secondo la mitologia Abyla era la moglie di Ercole dal quale ebbe un figlio chiamato Alcideo che avrebbe conquistato la penisola iberica e fondato una città alla quale impose il nome della madre Abyla. In effetti si sa dalle vestigia ritrovate che la zona di Avila fu abitata nel VII secolo a.C. da una popolazione celtica, i Vetoni, che la chiamarono Obila. Nel 237 a.C. Amilcare Barca si rifornì di soldati per il suo esercito facendo una leva militare dei giovani di Avila. I Romani vi installarono un accampamento militare costringendo i Vetoni ad abbandonare la città.Fonte Wikipedia

programme.title: About Henry / A proposito di Henry
programme.desc: Original title: Regarding Henry dramatic film by Mike Nichols Cast. With Harrison Ford, Annette Bening, Bill Nunn, Mikki Allen, Donald Moffat Paese - Year: USA -1991 Henry Turner is an established New York lawyer, mainly dedicated to work and career. With him live, without too much feeling, his wife Sarah and his twelve -year -old daughter. One evening, leaving the house to buy cigarettes, Henry is injured during a robbery. The brain damage seems first irreversible, but gradually Henry starts talking and moving. It is no longer the same, however: for him the family and the affections come to the first place, a child has returned that instinctively sends the social conventions and unmasks the false mechanisms of power. And finally, he is happy. / Titolo originale: Regarding Henry Film drammatico di Mike Nichols Cast. con Harrison Ford, Annette Bening, Bill Nunn, Mikki Allen, Donald Moffat Paese - Anno: USA -1991 Henry Turner è un affermato avvocato di New York, dedito soprattutto al lavoro e alla carriera. Con lui vivono, senza troppo sentimento, la moglie Sarah e la figlia dodicenne. Una sera, uscendo di casa per comprare le sigarette, Henry rimane ferito nel corso di una rapina. Il danno cerebrale sembra dapprima irreversibile, ma a poco a poco Henry riprende a parlare e a muoversi. Non è più lo stesso, però: per lui la famiglia e gli affetti vengono al primo posto, è ritornato un bambino che istintivamente manda allaria le convenzioni sociali e smaschera i falsi meccanismi del potere. E, finalmente, è felice.

programme.title: Albert's garden - shared waters / Il giardino di Albert - Acque condivise
programme.desc: All populations for centuries settled in the Alpine know that managing the water resource in an oculated and shared way is essential to be able to live and grow. The Vallesans of the Middle Ages also knew. Towards the thirteenth century they began to build an extraordinary network of channels, which collected glaciers' merger lacquares, to convey it to the valley and distribute it where there was a need. These channels are called "bisses" and today represent one historical testimony of hydraulic unhinestone made of common sense, audacity and pragmatism. Thanks to the bisses lagoraltura, viticulture and pastoralism Vallesane have been able to develop and thrive. People learned to share lacquets and manage them in an fair way. Unfortunately, by the end of the century, many glaciers are destined to disappear or at least reduce themselves drastically. What will be this network of channels? The water issue is crucial in the Canton Valais, already seriously affected by climate change. Between torrential rains, debrical flows, floods, late frosts, hailstorms and drought periods, the challenges are manifold and complex. The documentary proposed today by the Albert garden highlights these problems, reminding us that the management of water is not only an environmental, but also economic and social question. Faced with potential conflicts, the functioning of bisses - based on consortium management - could it represent a form of administration controlled by citizens for the sustainability of ecosystems? Between tourist, environmental, and socio -economic challenges, the Bisses Vallesani tell us a story that draws on ancestral knowledge to ferry them in about - ours - in which high -tech solutions may not be the only ones to offer us winning options. It is no coincidence that in 2023 the Bisses of the Valais entered the right to be part of the intangible heritage of the Unnesco. / Tutte le popolazioni da secoli insediate nellarco alpino sanno che gestire la risorsa idrica in maniera oculata e condivisa è fondamentale per poterci vivere e crescere. Lo sapevano anche i vallesani del Medioevo. Verso il XIII secolo iniziarono a costruire una straordinaria rete di canali, che raccoglieva lacqua di fusione dei ghiacciai, per convogliarla a valle e distribuirla dove vi era necessità. Questi canali sono chiamati "bisses" e rappresentano oggi uneccezionale testimonianza storica di uningegneria idraulica fatta di buon senso, audacia e pragmatismo. Grazie ai bisses lagricoltura, la viticoltura e la pastorizia vallesane hanno potuto svilupparsi e prosperare. La gente ha imparato a condividere lacqua e a gestirla in maniera equa. Purtroppo, entro la fine del secolo, molti ghiacciai sono destinati a scomparire o perlomeno a ridursi drasticamente. Che ne sarà di questa rete di canali? La questione idrica è cruciale nel Canton Vallese, già gravemente colpito dai cambiamenti climatici. Tra piogge torrenziali, colate detritiche, inondazioni, gelate tardive, grandinate e periodi di siccità, le sfide sono molteplici e complesse. Il documentario proposto oggi dal giardino di Albert mette in luce queste problematiche, ricordandoci che la gestione dellacqua non è soltanto una questione ambientale, ma anche economica e sociale. Di fronte a potenziali conflitti, il funzionamento dei bisses - basato sulla gestione consortile - potrebbe forse rappresentare una forma di amministrazione controllata dai cittadini per la sostenibilità degli ecosistemi? Tra sfide turistiche, ambientali, e socioeconomiche, i bisses vallesani ci raccontano una storia che attinge a saperi ancestrali per traghettarli in unepoca - la nostra - in cui le soluzioni high-tech potrebbero non essere le sole a offrirci delle opzioni vincenti. Non a caso nel 2023 i bisses del Vallese sono entrati di diritto a far parte del Patrimonio immateriale dellUmanità dellUNESCO.

programme.desc: The lady in yellow (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American yellow show, with the participation of Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small village, the fictitious Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of La Signora in Yellow is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the first choice of the manufacturer. The part had been initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however refused. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

Leurovision Song Contest was made accessible with initiatives both for the public who watched the show on television and for those who were on site. For example, the songs in competition were translated for the first time in Switzerland in the language of the international signs, as well as the live broadcast was translated into the three languages ​​of the national signs. The team of deaf translators and translators explain to Natasha the methods adopted to return not only the text in ISL, but also the emotions and the rhythm of the songs. An inclusive disco was used in the village of the Aurovision Song Contest, whose pulse flooring to the rhythm of music. In this way, deaf people were able to perceive the vibrations of the songs and participate in all respects in fun. Natasha Ruf accompanies us to discover an opportunity for enrichment for everyone, sealed with music and the pleasure of sharing ... / LEurovision Song Contest è un enorme evento musicale che coinvolge 37 Paesi. Nel 2025 è stato organizzato a Basilea, dato che Nemo, artista che rappresentava la Svizzera, ha vinto ledizione dello scorso anno. SEGNI ha dedicato una puntata a questa manifestazione e Natascha Ruf ci fa scoprire in che modo le persone sorde possono fruirne. LEurovision Song Contest è stato reso accessibile con delle iniziative sia per il pubblico che guardava lo spettacolo in televisione sia per coloro che erano presenti in loco. Ad esempio, i brani in concorso sono stati tradotti per la prima volta in Svizzera in lingua dei segni internazionale, così come la diretta è stata tradotta nelle tre lingue dei segni nazionali. La squadra di traduttrici e traduttori sordi spiegano a Natasha le modalità adottate per restituire in ISL non solo il testo, ma anche le emozioni e il ritmo delle canzoni. Nel villaggio dellEurovision Song Contest è stata adibita una discoteca inclusiva, il cui pavimento pulsa a ritmo di musica. In questo modo le persone sorde hanno potuto percepire le vibrazioni delle canzoni e partecipare a tutti gli effetti al divertimento. Natasha Ruf ci accompagna alla scoperta di unopportunità di arricchimento per tutti, suggellata della musica e dal piacere di condividere...

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: The lady in yellow (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American yellow show, with the participation of Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. He aired weekly on the CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV-Movie, until 2003 (as a wagon read with murder, the ballad of the lost boy and appointment with death). Angela Lansbury played the role of executive producer of the show in her last seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspective writer of yellow, which is often dealing with with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small village, the fictitious Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of La Signora in Yellow is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the first choice of the manufacturer. The part had been initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however refused. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni.Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: World Treasures - Rhodes / Tesori del Mondo - Rodi
programme.desc: Let's protect them. Let's not lose them. We know them. A series that punctures the RSI schedule makes us know the great treasures of the planet that hosts us.Rodi is the largest of the islands of the Dodecanese and the easternmost of the major islands of the Aegean Sea. It is located about 17.7 km from the coasts of Türkiye. The population amounts to 130,000 people (2004), of which about 60/70,000 reside in the city of Rhodes, the largest center. Rhodes is the capital of the Prefecture of Dodecanese and the Province of Rhodes, which also includes the nearby islands of Symi, Tilos, Halki and Kastellòriizo (Castelrosso). Strongly, he was famous for the giant of Rhodes, statue of the god Helios, one of the seven wonders of the world. The medieval city is considered assets of humans. It its territory is present larger water park deuropa: the toilet park. / Proteggiamoli. Non perdiamoli. Conosciamoli. Una serie che punteggia il palinsesto RSI ci fa conoscere i grandi tesori del pianeta che ci ospita.Rodi è la più grande delle isole del Dodecaneso e la più orientale delle maggiori isole del mar Egeo.È situata a circa 17,7 Km dalle coste della Turchia. La popolazione ammonta a 130.000 persone (2004), di cui circa 60/70.000 risiedono nella città di Rodi, il centro maggiore. Rodi è la capitale della prefettura del Dodecaneso e della Provincia di Rodi, che include anche le vicine isole di Symi, Tilos, Halki e Kastellòrizo (Castelrosso).Storicamente, era famosa per il Colosso di Rodi, statua del dio Helios, una delle sette meraviglie del mondo. La città medievale è considerata patrimonio dellumanità.Sul suo territorio è presente parco acquatico più grande dEuropa: il Water Park.

programme.title: Le Miracle Suisse
programme.desc: In Switzerland, we are not going to lie, we like a drink. White, preference. We love white so much that we put it in our national dish: the fondue. He makes us poetic, makes us sing, we celle him in memorable celebrations, and we drink it by speaking political in our cellars or carnotzets. But we do not produce only wine, do you know the history of the absinthe, also called the green fee, which was prohibited and distilleled in secret for years in the Val de Travers? And we have found a family of winegrowers whose grandfather appears in our archives. The Swiss miracle tells you health! / En Suisse, on ne va pas se mentir, on aime boire un coup. De blanc, de preference. On aime tellement le blanc que l’on en met dans notre plat national : la fondue. Il nous rend poetiques, nous fait chanter, on le celèbre dans des fetes memorables, et on le boit en parlant politique dans nos caves ou carnotzets. Mais nous ne produisons pas que du vin, connaissez-vous l’histoire de l’absinthe, egalement appelee la fee verte, qui fut interdite et distillee en secret pendant des annees dans le Val de Travers ? Et nous avons retrouve une famille de vignerons dont le grand-père apparaît dans nos archives. Le Miracle Suisse vous dit sante !

programme.title: Infrarouge
programme.desc: Finances, governance, health, police: does the canton of Vaud have a problem? Long erected as a model for its governance and its management of public funds, the canton of Vaud is seeing its aura tarnished. The Council of State is in crisis, it withdrew the finances at Valerie Dittli, finances which are precisely in bright red, the unions call for a mobilization against the budget cuts a few weeks after the demonstrations of hospital staff, and then in Lausanne, the municipal police are gangrenee by a "systemic racism". How to explain such an accumulation of crises? Is it a simple black series or would there be something rotten in the beautiful country of Vaud? Finances, governance, health, police: does the canton of Vaud have a problem? Infrared opens the debate, Wednesday, October 1 on RTS1. / Finances, gouvernance, sante, police : le canton de Vaud a-t-il un problème ? Longtemps erige en modèle pour sa gouvernance et sa gestion des deniers publics, le canton de Vaud est en train de voir son aura se ternir. Le Conseil d’État est en crise, il a retire les Finances à Valerie Dittli, des finances qui justement sont dans le rouge vif, les syndicats appellent à une mobilisation contre les coupes budgetaires quelques semaines après les manifestations du personnel hospitalier, et puis à Lausanne, la police municipale est gangrenee par un « racisme systemique ». Comment expliquer une telle accumulation de crises ? S’agit-il d’une simple serie noire ou y aurait-il quelque chose de pourri dans le beau pays de Vaud ? Finances, gouvernance, sante, police : le canton de Vaud a-t-il un problème ? Infrarouge ouvre le debat, mercredi 1er octobre sur RTS1.

programme.desc: Finances, governance, health, police: does the canton of Vaud have a problem? Long erected as a model for its governance and its management of public funds, the canton of Vaud is seeing its aura tarnished. The Council of State is in crisis, it withdrew the finances at Valerie Dittli, finances which are precisely in bright red, the unions call for a mobilization against the budget cuts a few weeks after the demonstrations of hospital staff, and then in Lausanne, the municipal police are gangrenee by a "systemic racism". How to explain such an accumulation of crises? Is it a simple black series or would there be something rotten in the beautiful country of Vaud? Finances, governance, health, police: does the canton of Vaud have a problem? Infrared opens the debate, Wednesday, October 1 on RTS1. / Finances, gouvernance, sante, police : le canton de Vaud a-t-il un problème ? Longtemps erige en modèle pour sa gouvernance et sa gestion des deniers publics, le canton de Vaud est en train de voir son aura se ternir. Le Conseil d’État est en crise, il a retire les Finances à Valerie Dittli, des finances qui justement sont dans le rouge vif, les syndicats appellent à une mobilisation contre les coupes budgetaires quelques semaines après les manifestations du personnel hospitalier, et puis à Lausanne, la police municipale est gangrenee par un « racisme systemique ». Comment expliquer une telle accumulation de crises ? S’agit-il d’une simple serie noire ou y aurait-il quelque chose de pourri dans le beau pays de Vaud ? Finances, gouvernance, sante, police : le canton de Vaud a-t-il un problème ? Infrarouge ouvre le debat, mercredi 1er octobre sur RTS1.

programme.desc: In the third season of «SRF Kids - Next Level», three primary classes from the cantons of Obwalden, Nidwalden and Lucerne give everything to dust off the large trophy and main prize: The schoolmen from Sachseln OW, Dallenwil NW and Lucerne would definitely like to take nights in the Zoo - in a yurt and experience what the animals in Drive night. programme.title: Srf bi the lut - hasen stories / SRF bi de Lut – Huttengeschichten
programme.desc: The Huttenwartin Petra to do all hands full on the pre -al phutting. Prosecco runs out in the middle of the high season. The “Snowfarming” project has the top priority: Huttenwart Felix and his team cover the snow with tarpaulins so that it does not melt away so quickly and the hates supplied with water until autumn-there is no plan B. / Auf der Voralphutte UR hat die Huttenwartin Petra alle Hande voll zu tun. Fur gute Stimmung sorgt auch das «Schwyzerorgeliduo Malchberg», mit Landlermusik mochte Petra noch mehr Leute in die Berge locken. Geht ihr Plan auf?Nach der Euphorie uber die neue Kuche auf der Glecksteinhutte BE wechselt die Stimmung abrupt. Simon der Jungste der Familie entdeckt im Teich tote Fische – und das Sterben der Fische ist nicht aufzuhalten. Was steckt hinter dem plotzlichen Tod der Tiere? Konnen sie auch sinnvoll sein, wenn sie Investitionen finanzieren – und wann kippt die Situation ins Gefahrliche?Diese und weitere Fragen bespricht Moderatorin Wasiliki Goutziomitros mit SRF-Frankreich-Korrespondentin Mirjam Mathis und Wirtschaftswissenschaftler Daniel Gros.

programme.desc: Third of Zwolf children, Ida Berger was born during the Second World War in a poor family of farmers. Even Fruh has to take heavy work. One day her mother gives her to a strange farmer - as a fashion. The father receives a new cow for his two -year daughter because his own animals succumb to a plague. Far away from home, Ida works from Fruh to Spat, has hunger and always wears the same dress. At 16 she is raped and pregnant. Your child will be released for adoption. As soon as Ida is back on the parents' farm, she is gone again because her father has owe: she has to take care of 100 cattle alone on a remote alp. To support you, you send her a servant - with which she is forced. Touched by her parents' brakes, she claims help as adults. Today Verena is a psychosocial consultant and helps others to cope with her trauma. Verena and her mother Ida have since taken a healing way of processing: "The scars remain - but they no longer have to hurt." / Als drittes von zwolf Kindern kommt Ida Berger wahrend des Zweiten Weltkriegs in einer armen Bauernfamilie zur Welt. Schon fruh muss sie schwere Arbeiten ubernehmen. Eines Tages gibt ihre Mutter sie einem fremden Bauern mit – als Verdingmadchen. Der Vater erhalt fur seine zwolfjahrige Tochter eine neue Kuh, da seine eigenen Tiere einer Seuche erliegen. Weit weg von zu Hause arbeitet Ida von fruh bis spat, hat Hunger und tragt immer dasselbe Kleid. Mit 16 wird sie vergewaltigt und schwanger. Ihr Kind wird zur Adoption freigegeben. Kaum ist Ida zuruck auf dem elterlichen Hof, gibt man sie erneut weg, da ihr Vater Schulden hat: Sie muss auf einer abgelegenen Alp allein fur 100 Rinder sorgen. Zur Unterstutzung schickt man ihr einen Knecht – mit dem sie zwangsverheiratet wird.Verena Geissbuhler wachst als eines von vier Kindern in diesem Umfeld auf. programme.title: GESUNDHEITHEUTE – Die Gesundheitssendung mit Dr. Jeanne Furst
programme.sub-title: GESUNDHEITHEUTE - Die Gesundheitssendung mit Dr. Jeanne Furst
programme.desc: There is a special form of therapy for people who have suffered from depression for more than two years and have no improvement: CBASP (Cognitive Behavioral Analysis System of Psychotherapy). The focus of this therapy is on the improvement of interpersonal relationships, the reduction of avoidance behavior and the alignment of the action of personal values. The program portrays a person concerned who has been suffering from chronic depression since their youth and has been successfully applied to CBASP. In recent years there has been great progress in diagnostics, i.e. in the case of laboratory tests of the blood, in the inclusion of the forecast and therapies. “Health today” shows how a woman suffering from CLL benefits from the newly gained knowledge. / Fur Menschen, die seit mehr als zwei Jahren an Depressionen leiden und keine Besserung erfahren, gibt es eine spezielle Therapieform: CBASP (Cognitive Behavioral Analysis System of Psychotherapy). Der Fokus dieser Therapie liegt auf der Verbesserung zwischenmenschlicher Beziehungen, dem Abbau von Vermeidungsverhalten und der Ausrichtung des Handelns an personlichen Werten. Die Sendung portratiert eine Betroffene, die seit ihrer Jugend an chronischen Depressionen leidet und bei der CBASP erfolgreich angewandt wurde.Die chronische lymphatische Leukamie (CLL) ist die haufigste Form von Blutkrebs bei Erwachsenen. In den letzten Jahren gab es grosse Fortschritte in der Diagnostik, also bei Laboruntersuchungen des Bluts, bei der Einschatzung der Prognose sowie bei Therapien. «gesundheitheute» zeigt, wie eine an CLL erkrankte Frau von den neu gewonnenen Erkenntnissen profitiert.
